lines.text: Balak struck his hands together in anger and told Balaam to flee home, saying Chemosh had denied his reward.

problems.problem: Its true detail "the LORD had denied his reward" isn't in Numbers 24:11 word for word.
Its wrong detail "Chemosh had denied his reward" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
